name: Morolimier
description: Humanity's best friend! Morozhounds have stunning endurance and gentle personalities. And so, humans fitted them with harnesses and had them pull sleds, forming the first transport teams on the snowy plains. Today, dog-pulled sleds have slowly become more of a tourist attraction in small border towns, with a tiny minority who still respect sledding as a traditional competitive sport. Still, the people of the snowfields continue to regard Morozhounds as the closest of companions.
